# Shuye Lab

> Apps and books for learning Chinese

Shuye Lab (书叶工作室) is an independent studio making apps for learning Chinese and tracking daily practice, as well as printed study books.

## Apps

- Kaihua: HSK 3.0 vocabulary with tone training (7-Day Tone Camp), spaced repetition, and character breakdowns. Available in English, Korean, and Thai. Coming soon to iOS and Android.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/apps/kaihua/

- ChiHeng: A quiet log for daily practice, helping learners track study streaks. Coming soon to iOS and Android.
  https://shuyelab.github.io/apps/chiheng/

## Books

Printed study books published on Amazon. Two are on sale now; the others are coming soon.

- Grid by Grid Chinese: handwriting and vocabulary workbooks for the new HSK 3.0 syllabus (Levels 1-4), with stroke order, tian zi ge grids and answer keys.
  Book 1 (HSK 3.0 Level 1, paperback) is on sale: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HS2NJF9Y
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/grid-by-grid-chinese/

- Civics in Two Languages: bilingual large-print study guides for the 2025 U.S. citizenship civics test, with free audio.
  Book 1 (Chinese and English) is on sale in paperback and Kindle: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HRVDM2DW
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/civics-in-two-languages/

- Chinese Classics in Parallel Text: original English translations of classical Chinese texts with the Chinese original and notes, starting with The Art of War (coming soon).
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/chinese-classics-parallel/

- Motif by Motif: chess tactics workbooks organized by tactical motif, with 570 positions checked with a chess engine (coming soon).
  https://shuyelab.github.io/books/motif-by-motif-chess/
